cause: run() keeps only the last 3000 characters of stdout/stderr; git diff --name-only output was 3330 bytes, truncating a path into a false disallowed path. The actual Git diff contained only reports/evidence.
correction: Archive historical captures byte for byte, verify each entry digest, retain original commits, rerun on the new archive commit, then use one final evidence-only commit with a shorter list of changed paths. Evaluator/workflow remain unchanged.
publication: The initial candidate branch was published before the failing guard stopped the shell sequence. Preserve it in history and add ordinary commits; no force/amend/reset.
